## Case Studies
- **449% → 49% CPU** — Cut CPU load 9x on multi-camera AI vision platform (casa-visitor-guardian). Profiled reader loops, capped OpenCV threads, tuned YOLOv8 inference cadence. 49% CPU on 4-core servers with full detection retained.
- **99.99% uptime** — Enterprise search web platform (SearchUnify). Hardened CI/CD, staged deploys, observability and rollback guardrails.
- **20+ hrs/week reclaimed** — GitOps automation (gitops repo). One-command git automation with AI commit messages via Groq/Ollama.
